xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: Gujarat State Financial Corportion is a body corporate established as a statutory Corporation by Governmnent of Gujarat pursuant to Section 3 (1) of State Financial Corporations Act, 1951, a Parliament statute created in accordance with Entry No. 43 of Union List. Composition of Board of Directors is governed by Sections 10, 15, 17 read with Section 4 (3) of the said Act which does not envisage induction of Independent Director on the Board of Directors. As advised by SEBI vide letter dated December 20, 2021 while seeking relaxations in compliance with Corporate Governance requirements, Corporation took up the matter with appropriate authorities in Government for amendments to SFCs Act, 1951 vide letter dated December 27, 2021 so as to align it with that of LODR. However, the representtion is still pending resulting into Corporation not inducting Independent Directors on the Boar of Directors and as a consequence non-availability of independent directors on the Committees of Board of Directors. Since compliance under LODR is beyond control of the Corporation as it is inconsistent with SFCs Act, Corporation may be allowed to comply with Corporate Governance requirements in such a manner that it is not violative of SFCs Act, 1951.

For the reasons stated elsewhere in this Report, since Board of Directors does not consist of independent directors, Committees constituted by the Board of Directors in compliance with LODR are not represented by independent directors. The Committees are constituted in such a manner that it does not violate the provisions of SFCs Act, 1951 and the Regulations made thereunder.
Corporation has not constituted Nomination and Remuneration Committee keeping in view the provisions contained in the SFCs Act. Directors are nominated or elected and remuneration is regulated by Sections 16 and 23 of SFCs Act, 1951. A raw is filled for the purpose of validation only in respect of Nomination and Remuneration Committee which may be ignored for consideration.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: Gujarat State Financial Corporation is a body corporate, established as statutory Corporation, by Government of Gujarat pursuant to Section 3 (1) of State Financial Corporations Act, 1951, a Parliament statute framed under Entry No. 43 of Union List. Composition of its Board of Directors, remuneration payable etc., differs from that of Companies Act, 2013. Being an establishment under a special statute, Corporation is bound to comply with the provisions of SFCs Act, 1951 and thus not in consonance with that of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. As directed by SEBI vide letter dated December 20, 2021, Corporation moved Government for amendments to SFCs Act, 1951 vide letter dated December 21, 2021 followed by reminders. However, amendments to SFCs Act is still awaited. Pending amendments, Corporation adhere to compliance of SFCs Act, 1951 and thus deviates from requirement of LODR and representations have been made to BSE Ltd to waive the fine imposed on the Corporation. Representations made to Government, SEBI and from time to time BSE Ltd may be taken into consideration for considering our request.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Fine as per SEBI Master Circular dated November 11, 2024
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Non-compliance with Regulations 17 (1), 17 (2A), 18 (1) and 19 (1)/19 (2) of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Total fine imposed was Rs.9,88,840/- for the quarter ended December 31, 2025. Corporation has requested BSE Ltd to waive the fine vide letter dated March 02, 2026. Since no remittence has been made, no impact is envisaged on financial or other activities of the Corporation.
